mechanism: Cenobamate inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing meloxicam levels; meloxicam may increase seizure risk by lowering seizure threshold and competing for protein binding.
action: Monitor for meloxicam toxicity (GI bleeding, renal effects) and seizure breakthrough; consider alternative analgesic or dose reduction of meloxicam; NSAIDs should be used cautiously in patients on antiepileptics.
